answers.answer: 1. Select 3 pods in a four-player game. 2. Place the lowest-numbered in A, next in B, then alternate A/B; all start Locked side up. 3. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults plus 1 additional Adult per player (7 Adults at four players).
answers.evidence: “3 pods for 3–4 players”; “1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 3 Adults, plus 1 additional Adult per player.”

answers.answer: 1. Remove Corporate and Personal cards for player counts above actual; shuffle separately and deal each one of each, hidden. 2. At the first Encounter (first Intruder miniature appearing), keep one and remove the other face down without anyone looking. 3. Rejected Objective is removed from game face down. 4. Eggs are not Intruders and do not trigger the choice.
answers.evidence: “first time an Intruder miniature ... appears”; “Eggs are not Intruders.”

answers.answer: 1. Discard the used Action card itself plus exactly two additional Action cards from hand (3 total); the other cards can be any Action cards. 2. Contamination cards cannot pay. 3. Choose one of the OR effects.
answers.evidence: “discard that card ... and pay its cost”; “Contamination cards ... can never be discarded to pay.”

answers.answer: 1. After completing their own round (after their one Action then passing), take 1 Light Wound for ending the round in the burning Room. 2. Once passed, no further normal Actions that Player Phase. 3. Passing allows discarding any number of hand cards. 4. Fire damage applies at the end of each Character’s round, once for that Character that turn; later players’ rounds do not burn this Character again.
answers.evidence: “ends their round ... suffers 1 Light Wound”; “only after finishing their own round.”

answers.answer: 1. Flip the face-down Room tile and resolve its Exploration token; set Item count by rotating tile so token number faces board’s Item Counter symbol (except Nest/Slime Room). 2. Resolve token effect, then remove token to box; Slime/Fire/Malfunction/Door etc. as shown. 3. If destination is empty, roll Noise; 1–4 place marker in numbered connected Corridor (Technical if entrance). 4. Silence means no roll; Slime makes Silence become Danger. Danger moves all eligible neighboring Intruders, or if none places Noise in every empty connected Corridor. If anyone is already in destination (Character or Intruder), do not roll Noise.
answers.evidence: “if the Room tile was unexplored ... reveal and resolve”; “If anyone ... is already there, do NOT roll.”

answers.answer: 1. Careful Movement costs 2 Action cards and replaces the post-move Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen Corridor connected to the destination; this also replaces automatic Silence/Danger exploration results. 2. Cannot use in Combat or if all Corridors connected to destination already contain Noise; normal Movement restrictions apply. 3. Closed Door blocks crossing. 4. No miniature can stop in Corridor; must occupy Rooms.
answers.evidence: “instead of a Noise roll ... place a Noise marker”; “cannot ... while in Combat.”

answers.answer: 1. On a roll directing Noise to already-marked Corridor, resolve Encounter: remove all Noise from Corridors connected to Room (including Technical entrance), draw bag token, place matching miniature. 2. A non-Blank drawn token is set aside outside bag, not returned immediately; if it later retreats into Technical Corridors its token returns. 3. Compare token number with triggering player’s hand size: fewer cards than number causes Surprise Attack against them; equal/more no attack. 4. Action and Contamination cards both count.
answers.evidence: “A Corridor may never hold more than 1 ... resolve an Encounter”; “Action AND Contamination cards both count.”

answers.answer: 1. Move ALL neighboring Intruders not in Combat with any Character into destination. 2. If none eligible (none nearby or all in Combat), place Noise in every connected Corridor without one. 3. Intruder moving into a Character’s Room is not an Encounter; they are simply in Combat. 4. Slime turns Silence into Danger.
answers.evidence: “move ALL eligible Intruders”; “merely moving ... is NOT an Encounter.”

answers.answer: 1. In an Encounter, Blank places Noise in every connected Corridor and no miniature appears. 2. Return Blank to bag. 3. If it was last token in bag, add an Adult if available. 4. In bag development, Blank adds an Adult if available and returns to bag; it does not place Noise.
answers.evidence: “Blank token in an Encounter ... place a Noise marker ... If ... LAST ... add 1 Adult”; “Blank — add 1 Adult.”

requested_parts: two Intruders through same Closed Door
answers.answer: 1. Both stay in originating Room; multiple Intruders attempting same Closed Door destroy it simultaneously. 2. Door token becomes lying/Destroyed. 3. Destroyed Doors cannot be closed again (except Plasma Torch). 4. An Intruder appearing due to Noise is not blocked by Closed Door.
answers.evidence: “all stay put”; “appears regardless of the Door.”

answers.answer: 1. Entering Technical Corridors removes miniature; discard its Injury markers and return its token to bag. 2. Existing Noise marker on Technical Corridors remains. 3. Characters normally cannot use ducts, except Mechanic’s Technical Corridors card and Technical Corridor Plans item. 4. Door tokens can never be placed there.
answers.evidence: “discard all its Injury markers, return its token ...”; “Noise marker ... NOT removed.”

answers.answer: 1. Shoot costs 1 Action card and 1 Ammo; target one Intruder in your Room with Weapon in Hand. 2. Melee costs 1 Action card, draws a Contamination card to top of discard, then targets one Intruder in your Room. 3. Shoot blank miss has no penalty; Melee miss gives attacker 1 Serious Wound. 4. Two-hit die result gives 2 Injuries for Shoot before weapon modifiers, but only 1 Injury in Melee.
answers.evidence: “Shoot (cost 1 Action card + 1 Ammo)”; “Melee ... draw 1 Contamination card.”

answers.answer: 1. Larva dies at 1 Injury; no Carcass. 2. Adult: draw one Attack card, blood value ≤ total Injuries means death, else survives. 3. Queen: draw two and sum blood; sum ≤ total Injuries kills. 4. Adult/Queen death places Carcass in Room. 5. If either Queen check card has Retreat arrow, retreat procedure replaces numerical check: draw Event, move by its Intruder corridor number, discard Event.
answers.evidence: “Queen ... Draw 2 Attack cards and sum blood values”; “EITHER ... shows Retreat.”

answers.answer: 1. Before moving, one Intruder Attack per Intruder in Room, larger first: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva. 2. Escape attack targets escaper. 3. If killed, Corpse stays in Room they tried to leave. 4. If survive, complete move to neighboring explored/unexplored Room, explore if needed and roll Noise only if destination empty.
answers.evidence: “one separate Attack per Intruder ... starting with larger”; “If you die, your Corpse stays.”

answers.answer: 1. Target Character with fewest Action cards in hand; tie goes to First Player token holder or next in turn order. Surprise targets triggerer; Escape targets escaper. 2. Draw one Intruder Attack card; matching attacker-type symbol means resolve effect, otherwise miss; ignore blood. 3. Larva draws no Attack card and instead Infests. 4. Larva is removed from Room and placed on Character board; target gains Contamination card atop Action discard. If already Larva, attacker disappears, existing stays and only Contamination is gained.
answers.evidence: “fewest Action cards”; “place it on top of their Action discard pile.”

answers.answer: 1. Dressing merely ignores Serious Wound effect; it still counts, so at 3 Serious Wounds any further Wound kills even if one dressed. 2. Third Light Wound clears Light track and causes a Serious Wound. 3. Heal removes a Light Wound or discards a Dressed Serious Wound as specified. 4. On death place Corpse Object in Room and drop all Heavy Objects there; Item cards disappear from game.
answers.evidence: “Dressing does not prevent death”; “drop all their Heavy Objects.”

answers.answer: 1. Canteen/Shower scan all Contamination cards in hand only; remove scanned non-Infected cards. Infected stays; if no Larva place Larva, if existing Larva character dies and Creeper enters death Room. 2. Canteen heals 1 Light Wound; Shower removes Slime; either non-scanning benefit is listed separately and can accompany scan. 3. Surgery scans all cards in hand, deck, discard; removes all Infected and removes Larva if present. 4. Surgery then inflicts 1 Light Wound, automatically passes, shuffles all cards including hand into Action deck; hand empty until next turn, and gives no new Contamination.
answers.evidence: “Canteen ... all Contamination cards in your HAND”; “Surgery ... suffer 1 Light Wound and automatically pass.”

answers.answer: 1. In Room with uncarried Eggs, Shoot/Melee against them; each Injury destroys 1 Egg. Successful Egg Melee retains normal Contamination draw; missed Egg Melee causes neither Contamination nor Wound but draw timing is unresolved. 2. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs; Molotov 1. 3. Missed Egg Melee waives both ordinary Melee Wound and Contamination, timing unclear; no other penalties identified. 4. Noise roll after every single attempt to destroy an Egg. 5. When no Eggs remain on board in Nest, Nest is destroyed and marked with 1 Injury.
answers.evidence: “After every single attempt”; “When no Eggs remain ... Nest is destroyed.”

answers.answer: 1. Pay 2 cards for Evacuation Section Room Action; Pod must be unlocked and have space; Section cannot contain Intruder or Malfunction. 2. Roll Noise first; if Intruder appears/reaches Section entry fails. 3. Pod capacity 2 Characters; Heavy Objects take no character space. 4. After boarding may launch immediately; otherwise pass current turn and remain present for bag-development Noise. At start of first round in each later Player Phase choose exactly one: wait/pass, launch, or exit free to Section Room and take full 2-Action round. Intruder appearing sends pod occupants back to Room; a second boarder may launch both immediately.
answers.evidence: “A Pod there must be Unlocked with a free Character space”; “choose exactly one.”

answers.answer: 1. Checks: Engines → Coordinates → Contamination → Objectives. 2. Two or three Damaged Engines cause ship explosion; everyone aboard dies, including sleepers and Intruders; Pod passengers away. 3. Non-Earth kills hibernators (ship remains intact); Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. 4. At contamination: scan all Contamination if no Larva; if any infected or Larva, shuffle all Action/Contamination from deck, hand, discard and draw top 4; any Contamination among four kills. 5. Launched Pod passengers undergo same check; no special exemption.
answers.evidence: “every surviving Character, including launched Pod passengers”; “Engines → Coordinates → Contamination → Objectives.”

answers.answer: 1. Shuffle tiles unseen and put one matching each 1/2 slot face down; shuffle Exploration tokens unseen, one per Room; return extras unseen. 2. One random Coordinates card face down by Cockpit; Destination marker starts B and Time marker green. 3. For each Engine shuffle one Working and one Damaged face down and stack; top is true status. 4. Board starts 5 Egg tokens and 3 random face-down Weakness cards.
answers.evidence: “one face down on each Room slot”; “Place 1 Status marker on the ‘B’ space.”

answers.answer: 1. Random Help card numbered 1 to player count sets Player Number and draft order. 2. In order, each draws 2 Character cards publicly, keeps one and shuffles other back. 3. Each takes Character board/miniature, shuffled 10-card Action deck, Starting Weapon loaded to capacity, and 2 Quest Items horizontal/inactive. 4. Characters begin Hibernatorium; blue Corpse begins Hibernatorium. 5. Quest Items are not usable immediately; unlock via conditions/mini-quests.
answers.evidence: “Objectives before Character draft”; “NOT active at the start.”

answers.answer: 1. Each Player Phase before rounds, draw to 5 (6 with Cabins). 2. Pass token left after drawing, except first turn. 3. If Action deck empty, shuffle discard pile into new deck and draw. 4. Normal discards face up: Actions to own discard, Contamination atop same, Items to matching discard, Event/Attack/Wound to respective piles; special Search rejected card face down to bottom of chosen Item deck.
answers.evidence: “after drawing, pass ... (do NOT pass ... first turn)”; “Normal discards are face up.”

answers.answer: 1. Advance Time and active Self-Destruct; Intruder Attacks; Fire Damage; Event card movement then effect; bag development. 2. Intruders showing event symbol and not in a Room with Characters move. 3. Corridor number on card controls destination; Technical corridor sends it back to bag/removes mini. Resolve card effect after movement. 4. Empty Event deck reshuffles discards; empty Intruder Attack deck reshuffles its discard.
answers.evidence: “after the movement step, resolve the effect”; “If Event deck ever runs out ... shuffle.”

answers.answer: 1. Larva removed from bag, add Adult. Creeper removed, add Breeder. 2. Adult returned immediately before all players roll Noise in order, skip Combat; Encounter can draw that same Adult. 3. Breeder: players roll Noise in order skipping Combat, then return Breeder. 4. Queen: if Characters in Nest, place miniature and resolve Encounter; else add Egg to board; return Queen. 5. Larva/Creeper tokens do not return; other specified tokens return as above; Noise rolls occur for Adult/Breeder only; next turn begins after all development/encounters resolve.
answers.evidence: “Adult ... return ... immediately before all players roll”; “End ... once bag development ... fully resolved.”

answers.answer: 1. 9th Fire or Malfunction placement ends game with ship explosion/hull loss; also Self-Destruct final skull space. 2. If target already has marker, max one per Room, extra placements do nothing. 3. Removed/discarded markers return appropriate pool. 4. Hull loss kills all aboard, awake/hibernating, and everything else aboard including Intruders.
answers.evidence: “if instructed to place a 9th ... ship explodes”; “Max 1 per Room.”

answers.answer: 1. Disables Room Action and Computer; does not prevent Searching. 2. Other permitted things remain usable, including Search and applicable Engine checks/repair. 3. Never place in Nest or Room Covered With Slime; cannot be placed unexplored. 4. Does not change Engine token status; Hibernatorium malfunction does not affect already-hibernating Character.
answers.evidence: “Room’s Action is unavailable (Searching still works)”; “Engine status is never affected.”

answers.answer: 1. Normal Item cards in holder are hidden; others see backs/colors. 2. No inventory size limit. 3. Must show any Item when used. 4. Heavy Items/Objects occupy one of 2 Hand slots, visible; max 2 carried. 5. Found Weapons start with 1 Ammo; max capacity. Add Items attach to another card and count as one; Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items (not Objects) into one slot.
answers.evidence: “No Inventory size limit”; “Any Item used must be shown.”

answers.answer: 1. Dropped Objects stay in Room; dropped Items lost to discard. 2. Drop free at any time during own turn, no Action. 3. Searched Weapons come with 1 Ammo; starting Weapon loaded to printed capacity.
answers.evidence: “Drop: free, any time during your turn”; “Weapons found by Searching come loaded with 1 Ammo.”

answers.answer: 1. Search deck must match Room color; white Room allows Red/Yellow/Green choice; Blue Crafted never searched. 2. Draw 2 from one deck, keep one, return other face down to bottom. 3. Each Search lowers Item Counter by 1. 4. At zero ordinary Search unavailable (Scout Scavenging exception). 5. Nest and Slime Room prohibit any Search Action; Special Rooms no Searching.
answers.evidence: “draws 2 cards from one deck, keeps 1”; “Nest and Room Covered With Slime explicitly prohibit.”

answers.answer: 1. Craft Basic Action costs 1 Action card, discard 2 Items with matching blue component icons. 2. Result must be available in Craft deck. 3. May look through Craft deck at any time. 4. Crafted items: Antidote flame+medical cross; Taser battery/lightning+screwdriver/tool; Flamethrower flame+screwdriver/tool; Molotov flame+folded cloth/fabric.
answers.evidence: “cannot be built if its card is not available”; component list.

answers.answer: 1. Only initiator spends Action; all Characters in Room may trade, including non-initiating pairs if mutually agreed. 2. May give Item/Object for nothing; empty Trade with no intent disallowed, genuine negotiations may end without exchange. 3. Ammo cannot be exchanged. 4. Heavy Item found by Search does not require separate Pick Up; that action is for Objects.
answers.evidence: “Only the initiator spends”; “Heavy Items found by Searching do not require this Action.”

answers.answer: 1. Corresponding Object types: Character Corpse, Intruder Carcass, Egg correspond to Weakness cards. 2. Object must be present in Laboratory for Analyse; Scientist Intranet does not change that. 3. Object is not consumed. 4. Revealed Weakness benefits all players. 5. Objective requires corresponding Object researched in Laboratory by anyone, not personally.
answers.evidence: “Analyse 1 Object ... reveal corresponding Weakness”; “by anyone.”

answers.answer: 1. Room Action costs 2 Action cards; must be in Room, not in Combat and no Malfunction. 2. Computer icon itself has no effect; it enables relevant Computer interactions and Malfunction disables it. 3. Fire does not prevent Room Actions or Searching; character ending own round in Fire takes Light Wound.
answers.evidence: “Room Actions ... cost 2”; “Searching still work in burning Rooms.”

answers.answer: 1. Armory recharges one of your Energy Weapons. 2. Add 2 Ammo. 3. Not Classic weapons and cannot exceed capacity.
answers.evidence: “add 2 Ammo to 1 of your Energy Weapons.”

answers.answer: 1. Emergency Room choose exactly one: dress all Serious Wounds OR heal 1 Dressed Serious Wound OR heal all Light Wounds. 2. Dressing flips Serious Wound face down, suppressing effect but does not remove it/count. 3. Identical Serious Wound effects do not stack.
answers.evidence: “Dress ALL ... OR Heal 1 ... OR Heal all”; “Duplicate ... NOT cumulative.”

answers.answer: 1. Comms Room Action places Status marker on player board’s Signal space; used for Send the Signal Objective. 2. Comms Room always aboard normal game.
answers.evidence: “Comms Room is always aboard.”

answers.answer: 1. Fire Control chooses any Room; if Fire there, discard it. 2. All Intruders in chosen Room flee in random directions, each using an Event card; works even without Fire.
answers.evidence: “discard its Fire marker (if any) and ALL Intruders there run away.”

answers.answer: 1. In the Generator Room, the 2-card Room Action starts the sequence by placing its marker on the first green space; use the same Room Action to stop it by removing the marker. Restarting begins again on green. 2. Advance it one space whenever Time advances. 3. At the first yellow space, Pods unlock and the sequence can no longer be stopped; later yellow spaces do not unlock relocked Pods; the final skull space explodes the ship. 4. A hyperspace jump while Self-Destruct is active still counts as ship destruction. 5. A Character cannot start it while anyone is hibernating; Coolant Leak Event can start it despite a sleeper.
answers.evidence: “first yellow ... can no longer be aborted”; “Coolant Leak Event can.”

answers.answer: 1. Target any other Yellow Room. 2. Connected Corridors must contain no Destroyed Doors. 3. Immediately close every Door around it and put Procedure token. 4. If all remain Closed until current Player Phase ends after all pass, everything there dies and Fire removed; opening any Door cancels.
answers.evidence: “any 1 OTHER Yellow Room”; “If any ... opened first, procedure is cancelled.”

answers.answer: 1. At start of new turn, Character in Cabins with no Intruders draws one extra, hand 6 rather than 5. 2. Malfunction disables benefit. 3. Passive, not paid Room Action.
answers.evidence: “passive: at the start of a new turn”; “6 instead of 5.”

answers.answer: 1. Command Center may choose any Room, including distant. 2. Open/Close any selected Doors in its connected Corridors; may choose some open, some close. 3. Destroyed Door cannot be closed normally.
answers.evidence: “choose any 1 Room and Open/Close any ... (your choice which)”; “Destroyed ... can never be Closed again.”

answers.answer: 1. Engine Control Room checks status of all 3 Engines; cannot change status there. 2. Works even if an Engine Room has Malfunction.
answers.evidence: “check the status of all 3 Engines”; “works even if ... Malfunction.”

answers.answer: 1. Hatch Control flips one Escape Pod token Locked/Unlocked. 2. Monitoring inspects any 1 unexplored Room tile and its Exploration token together. 3. It is secret; you may lie. 4. Replace both face down afterward.
answers.evidence: “look at any 1 unexplored Room tile and its Exploration token, then replace them.”

answers.answer: 1. No Action to gain Slime: entering automatically gives marker before exploration. 2. No Item count; Malfunction never placed there. 3. Max one Slime marker; further does nothing. 4. Shower removes Slime only, not Fire; Fire can remain.
answers.evidence: “entering automatically gives you a Slime marker”; “Fire ... NOT removed.”

answers.answer: 1. Check Coordinates privately/secretly look at Coordinates card, may lie and replace; or Set Destination by moving marker. 2. Information is secret. 3. Destination marker selects one of four destination entries on Coordinates card. 4. Cannot set with Intruder in Cockpit or change after anyone hibernates.
answers.evidence: “secretly look”; “marker selects one of the four destination entries.”

answers.answer: 1. Check Engine privately looks at top token; Repair/Break examines both tokens and restacks any order. 2. May keep result secret/lie. 3. Must announce if changed token order, not whether repaired. 4. No prior check or functioning Engine Room required; works despite Malfunction.
answers.evidence: “needn’t say whether ... but MUST say if changed the order”; “without checking first.”

answers.answer: 1. Hibernation only when Time blue, in Hibernatorium, pay 2 cards, no Intruder/Malfunction. 2. Roll Noise; Intruder appearing/reaching Room causes failure. 3. Success remove miniature; stops participating until end checks. 4. Once anyone sleeps, cannot change Destination or initiate Self-Destruct as Character. 5. Later Malfunction does not wake/harm sleepers.
answers.evidence: “Time on a blue space”; “Once anyone hibernates ... no one may change Destination.”

answers.answer: 1. Time final red causes immediate jump; non-hibernating aboard Characters die. Game also ends if last active non-hibernating Character dies, sleeps or launches: advance active Self-Destruct to final, otherwise Time to final and resolve. 2. Active Self-Destruct on jump means ship considered destroyed. 3. Intruders unharmed by normal jump.
answers.evidence: “Intruders are unharmed by the hyperjump”; “if Self-Destruct sequence was active ... final.”

answers.answer: 1. Characters cannot directly attack each other due to anti-aggression implants. 2. Indirect harm allowed: lock someone in burning Room, activate Self-Destruct with crew aboard, or throw Grenade into Room with crew.
answers.evidence: “can never directly attack”; examples.

answers.answer: 1. If all 8 Adult models on board, remove all Adults not in Combat, return their tokens to bag if possible, then place Adult at Encounter Room. If all 8 in Combat, summary says procedure unresolved. 2. Intruder ending movement in unexplored Room remains; do not reveal tile or Exploration token.
answers.evidence: “If all 8 Adults are in Combat ... authoritative clarification is needed”; “do not ... reveal.”

answers.answer: 1. Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper only; misses others. 2. Larger curved hits Larva/Creeper/Adult; misses Breeder/Queen. 3. Melee uses same target restrictions; ineligible result is miss and attacker takes Serious Wound.
answers.evidence: Die result table.

requested_parts: final scan no Larva and all noninfected
answers.answer: 1. With no Larva, scan every Contamination card in deck, hand and discard. 2. If all are non-Infected, no four-card draw and cards are not removed merely for scan. 3. Pod passenger still undergoes Contamination and Objective checks.
answers.evidence: “If none is Infected, there is no four-card draw”; “does not remove cards merely because ... non-Infected.”

answers.answer: 1. Antidote: flame + medical cross. 2. Taser: battery/lightning + screwdriver/tool. 3. Flamethrower: flame + screwdriver/tool. 4. Molotov: flame + folded cloth/fabric.
answers.evidence: “four Crafted Items and their component symbols.”

answers.answer: 1. In Combat whenever Intruder in same Room. 2. In Combat Only/Out of Combat Only restrictions apply as printed. 3. Unmarked card/Item Actions usable in either if requirements met. 4. Eggs are not Intruders and do not cause Combat.
answers.evidence: “Eggs do not count as Intruders.”

answers.answer: 1. Need only have Player X dead at end; need not kill them personally. 2. Hibernating or escaped character is not dead, so does not satisfy. 3. Only survivor Objective means no other Character survives. 4. Regardless, own Character must survive via Pod or hibernation.
answers.evidence: “must simply be dead ... not hibernated, not escaped”; “Regardless ... your Character must survive.”

answers.answer: 1. If no Door tokens in pool, move any Door token from elsewhere on board. 2. Open = no token; Closed = standing token; Destroyed = lying token. 3. Max 1 Door per Corridor. 4. Cannot place in Technical Corridors.
answers.evidence: “move any Door token from elsewhere”; “max 1 per Corridor.”

requested_parts: immediate Pod unlock on first death
answers.answer: 1. First Character death automatically unlocks every Escape Pod. 2. They may subsequently be locked/unlocked normally, e.g. Hatch Control.
answers.evidence: “all Escape Pods are automatically Unlocked”; “may be Locked/Unlocked normally.”

answers.answer: 1. Storage Room Action draws 2 from chosen Red/Yellow/Green deck, keep 1. 2. Return rejected face down to bottom of chosen deck. 3. Room Actions cost 2 cards, require presence, no Combat and no Malfunction; Storage action can be used repeatedly at zero counter.
answers.evidence: “Storage — draw 2 cards”; “counter limits only Search Action card.”

answers.answer: 1. In Nest take 1 Egg token from Intruder board via Room Action; costs 2 cards. 2. Immediately make Noise roll. 3. Picking up an already-dropped Egg Object in Room is Basic Pick Up Heavy Object, cost 1, with no Noise-roll instruction; it no longer counts as Nest Egg.
answers.evidence: “take 1 Egg token ... then make a Noise roll”; “Basic pickup has no Noise-roll instruction.”

answers.answer: 1. After paying its Action card cost, showing it, and using its printed Action, discard the One Use Only Item card.
answers.evidence: “‘One Use Only’ Items are discarded after use.”

answers.answer: 1. Launched Pod occupants count as arriving on Earth. 2. This says nothing that the ship itself reached Earth; ship destination is separately checked by Coordinates.
answers.evidence: “count as arriving on Earth”; separate ship Coordinates rule.

answers.answer: 1. Yes. Waiting Pod occupants remain treated as present in the Evacuation Section for bag-development Noise rolls.
answers.evidence: “remain treated as present in the Section for Noise rolls.”

answers.answer: 1. Can still wait, launch, or exit. 2. Section Malfunction blocks only new entry into Pods.
answers.evidence: “may still wait, launch or exit; ... blocks only new entry.”

answers.answer: 1. Resolve one Attack per Intruder before movement, starting largest: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva.
answers.evidence: “one separate Attack per Intruder ... larger ones.”

answers.answer: 1. Remove Event from game as instructed even if its other effect cannot resolve.
answers.evidence: “Remove an Event ... even when its other effect cannot resolve.”

answers.answer: 1. Return drawn Adult to bag immediately before all players roll Noise. 2. Yes, an Encounter triggered by those rolls may draw that same Adult.
answers.evidence: “An Encounter ... may draw that same Adult token.”

answers.answer: 1. Normally retreating Intruder destroys Closed Door and stays in place. 2. Under The Way of Moving Weakness, affected Intruder except Breeder/Queen does nothing at Door.
answers.evidence: “destroys it and stays”; “instead does nothing.”

requested_parts: Hand Serious Wound effect on Basic Shoot
answers.answer: 1. No. Hand Serious Wound does not increase Basic Shoot cost because Shoot is Basic Action, not Item Action.
answers.evidence: “does not increase Basic Shoot cost because Shoot is a Basic Action.”

answers.answer: 1. Adds one Injury per damage instance (x+1), not per injury. 2. Flamethrower two-crosshair hit deals 3 Injuries.
answers.evidence: “1 additional Injury per damage instance”; “therefore deals 3.”

answers.answer: 1. Attacking Larva disappears from board. 2. Existing Larva remains on Character board. 3. Character receives one Contamination card but is not automatically killed.
answers.evidence: “existing one stays ... only gains the Contamination card.”

answers.answer: 1. Sleeper takes no Fire wounds in Hibernatorium. 2. Ship destruction still kills sleepers; endgame survival checks can also kill them.
answers.evidence: “takes no later Fire wounds”; “ship destruction and ... checks still matter.”

answers.answer: 1. Yes, Coolant Leak Event may start Self-Destruct while someone hibernates. 2. Character cannot initiate it while anyone hibernates.
answers.evidence: “Coolant Leak Event can ... despite sleepers.”

answers.answer: 1. Discarded/dead Intruder tokens return to unused token pool. 2. They remain reusable, not permanently removed.
answers.evidence: “return to the unused token pool and remain reusable.”

answers.answer: 1. Fire may be placed in unexplored Rooms. 2. Malfunction cannot be placed in unexplored Rooms.
answers.evidence: “Fire markers can”; “Malfunction markers cannot.”

requested_parts: two existing Light + two more result
answers.answer: 1. First additional Light converts existing two Light into one Serious Wound; second additional Light remains as one Light Wound. Final: one Serious and one Light.
answers.evidence: “Two Light Wounds ... become 1 Serious Wound plus 1 remaining Light Wound.”

answers.answer: 1. Heavy Objects are dropped in Room. 2. Item cards disappear from game.
answers.evidence: “Heavy Objects drop in the Room, while Item cards disappear.”

answers.answer: 1. No. Only first yellow unlocks Pods; later yellow spaces do not unlock them again after relocking.
answers.evidence: “subsequent yellow spaces do not unlock them again.”

answers.answer: 1. Ship destruction fulfills kill Queen/destroy Nest requirements. 2. It alone does not make your Character a winner; must survive and fulfill Objective.
answers.evidence: “your Character must still survive and fulfill their Objective.”

answers.answer: 1. No, empty Action with no intention of exchange is disallowed. 2. Honest negotiations may end without trade.
answers.evidence: “Empty Actions ... disallowed”; “Honest negotiations may end with no trade.”

answers.answer: 1. Activation is Basic Action printed on card, cost 1 and out of Combat. 2. Cannot activate in Combat. 3. Room Malfunction does not prevent activation.
answers.evidence: “cost-1 Basic Action, out of Combat”; “Malfunction does not prevent.”

Permitted unmarked Action-card/Item actions may be used if requirements met; restrictions marked Out of Combat still apply.
answers.evidence: “Basic Actions in Combat are limited to ...”; “Unmarked ... work in or out.”

answers.answer: 1. Soldier may use Covering Fire for themselves alone. 2. Both moved Characters choose their direction. 3. Make one Noise roll. 4. Encounter Surprise comparison uses Soldier’s hand.

answers.answer: 1. Discard all Ammo from Assault Rifle and perform one Shoot. Additional damage equals half Ammo discarded rounded down plus Assault Rifle +1 bonus, in addition to Shoot result.
answers.evidence: “damage adds the Shoot result, half discarded Ammo rounded down, and ... +1.”

answers.answer: 1. Soldier may see Intruder Attack card before choosing whether to use Nerves of Steel. 2. Can protect Soldier when another Character triggered Surprise Attack, but only Soldier benefits; others still take effects such as Frenzy.

answers.answer: 1. Careful Movement or Reconnaissance replaces/cancels automatic Silence/Danger Exploration results; apply chosen movement ability instead of automatic result.

answers.answer: 1. Captain cannot use Order while personally in Combat. 2. Intercom may direct someone else to Move out of Combat; apply normal Escape rule/attacks.

answers.answer: 1. All Characters in Rooms with a Computer plus all Characters in Captain’s Room can draw via Motivation with active Intercom.

answers.answer: 1. No automatic pass after completing two Actions with empty hand; wait next round to pass. 2. Extra round can incur another Fire or Bleeding effect.

answers.answer: 1. Several Infected cards scanned while no Larva before action place just one Larva; this alone does not kill. 2. Rest can be fatal if Larva was already on board before it.

answers.answer: 1. Destroys 2 Eggs per Fire Damage step (one normal plus one extra per damage instance).
answers.evidence: “Fire in the Nest destroys 2 Eggs ... with this Weakness.”

answers.answer: 1. No. Dropped Egg is normal Heavy Object and does not restore Nest’s Egg total/hit points.

answers.answer: 1. Yes, adding Extended Magazine or Auto Loader to used/empty Energy Weapon immediately grants extra Ammo.

answers.answer: 1. Antidote scans all Contamination in hand, deck, discard; removes all Infected and removes Larva if present. 2. Gain one new Contamination. 3. Reshuffle new card with non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards, except cards retained in hand; then pass, may keep hand cards. 4. Surgery also removes Larva, but gives no new Contamination, shuffles entire hand too, costs 1 Light Wound and automatically passes.

answers.answer: 1. Slime marker goes on Character board when entering Slime exploration result (or Room entry effect). 2. Fire marker in entered Room. 3. Malfunction marker in entered Room (but not unexplored placement; Nest/Slime forbidden). 4. Door token in Corridor by which entered.
answers.evidence: “Doors — place a Door token in the Corridor by which you entered.”

answers.answer: 1. Bandages: choose Dress 1 Serious Wound OR Heal all Light Wounds. Cannot heal an undressed Serious Wound directly. 2. Clothes: discard Slime OR Dress 1 Serious Wound. 3. Each costs 1 Action card, One Use Only. 4. Alternatives cannot combine in one use.
answers.evidence: Item table: “OR”; “Choose only one effect.”

requested_parts: automatic Event after one round each?
answers.answer: 1. No; players take repeating rounds until all have passed. 2. First Player starts each round, clockwise. 3. Each active player gets up to 2 Actions per round. 4. One Action then must pass; zero Actions/chooses not to means pass; after passing no more normal Actions. 5. Player Phase ends only once all players passed; then Event Phase starts.
answers.evidence: “Series of rounds repeat as long as at least one player has not passed.”
